about: The rows of Model > Game review > Lord push (R-633): Lord pushes picked from late games for his grade and mark, written by tools/golden/review.py lord on the engine branch. Lord damage (R-632): gvg.report's own figure is the one of record; what is stored of it is each Lord's total for the match (`damage.match_gvg`, their Lord then the pushing team's own), set beside the engine's sum of the recorded hits for the push (`damage.push`) and for the match (`damage.match_hits`). His marks are in lord_row_marks.json, never here. On 2026-11-23 the rows of BcS v hold 25:25 and Apes v Crew 23:26 were taken off at his word, unmarked (R-643); and the two rows of hdm v Men, which he cannot review (R-645); four rows remain, all marked. Rows with `kind` "end" are the draft reading of the play for 28:00 (tools/golden/endplay.py rows, R-640 to R-646): one row a match for both teams, whom each sends and keeps and since when; their Lord damage is the engine's sum of the recorded hits from the first send, beside gvg.report's match total.
